PatientName.description: Patient first and last name, usually at the top of the page or in a demographics block. May be labeled Patient, Patient Name, Member, or appear as Last, First.

PatientDOB.description: Patient date of birth. Labeled DOB, D.O.B., Date of Birth, or Birth Date. Typically MM/DD/YYYY. Do not confuse with the date the form was written.

PatientAddress.description: Patient mailing or shipping address. Often spans two lines; the second line may hold an apartment, suite, or unit number.

PatientPhone.description: Patient telephone number. Labeled Phone, Home Phone, Mobile, Cell, or Contact Number. Capture digits as printed, including area code.

PatientGender.description: Patient gender. Usually a checkbox pair labeled M/F or Male/Female. Return Unknown if no box is marked or the marking is ambiguous.

ProviderName.description: Prescribing or treating provider name, sometimes with a credential such as MD, DO, NP, or PA. Labeled Provider, Prescriber, Physician, or Doctor. Not the practice or facility name.

ProviderNPI.description: Prescriber National Provider Identifier. Always exactly 10 digits. Labeled NPI, NPI #, Provider NPI, or NPI Number. If more than one NPI appears, take the one belonging to the prescribing provider.

ProviderAddress.description: Provider or practice address, usually in the letterhead or prescriber block. Distinct from the patient address.

ProviderPhone.description: Provider office telephone number, from the letterhead or prescriber block. Not the fax number.

ProviderFax.description: Fax number for the provider office or the payer, as printed. Labeled Fax, Fax #, or Fax Number.

Signature.description: Whether a handwritten or electronic provider signature mark appears in the signature area. Detect presence of a mark, do not transcribe a name.

SupervisingPhysicianNPI.description: Supervising physician NPI, when a mid-level provider prescribes. Exactly 10 digits. Distinct from the prescriber NPI. Empty if absent.

DrugName.description: Prescribed drug name as written, brand or generic, including any strength printed alongside it. Resolved against reference data by us.

DrugDirections.description: Dosing directions or SIG, verbatim. May describe loading, maintenance and induction dosing in one block. Mapped to a Helix SIG code by us, so capture the full text rather than summarising.

DoseForm.description: Dose form selected on the form, typically a checkbox group. Return Not documented if no box is marked.

PrescriptionStrength.description: Prescribed strength with units as printed, for example 40 mg/0.8 mL. May be a checkbox selection rather than free text.

DateWritten.description: Date the prescriber wrote or signed the prescription. Labeled Date, Date Written, or Date Signed. Not the patient date of birth.

Refills.description: Number of refills authorized, as printed. May be a numeral, a word, or PRN / NR. Empty if not stated.

Quantity.description: Quantity dispensed, with units if printed, for example 2 syringes or 30 tablets.
